emergency_signs.reason: Severe breathing difficulty can be life-threatening.
Chest pain, especially with sweating, fainting, nausea, or shortness of breath, may require urgent assessment.

emergency_signs.sign: Sudden weakness or numbness on one side
emergency_signs.reason: Sudden one-sided weakness or numbness can be a warning sign of a serious neurological emergency.
These symptoms can indicate a serious neurological emergency.
Loss of consciousness or a seizure requires urgent medical assessment.
Sudden severe confusion can be associated with serious medical conditions.
Significant uncontrolled bleeding can become dangerous quickly.
Breathing difficulty or swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat can be life-threatening.
A sudden severe headache unlike usual headaches, especially with neurological symptoms, needs urgent evaluation.
Severe dehydration or inability to keep fluids down can become dangerous.
A rapidly worsening condition that feels life-threatening should not be managed at home.
